'''Kay Tallon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon's]] wife.

==Biography==
Adar Tallon, legendary hero from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and later fugitive of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], faked his own death and went hiding on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. There, he met and later married Kay. With some savings, Tallon could afford having two servants, [[Morr Wenn|Morr]] and [[Cala Wenn]], and a majordomo droid, [[LN-26]].

After an amount of years living with Adar, a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] came [[Escape from Tatooine|looking for him]]. Although Adar had friends that helped him to defend himself, such as [[Vytor Shrike]], [[Jungen]] and [[Quist (pirate)|Quist]], the old commander decided that he was no longer safe on Tatooine, specially once Quist betrayed him and a team of Rebel agents protecting him. Adar Tallon decided to leave Tatooine and join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Kay and LN-26 would go with him.

After that, Tallon became commanding officer of a small fleet, including the cruiser ''[[Silent Water]]'' as flagship.
